reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering pasta, flower and wild seeds, targeted bait, fertilizer, forage, prepared fish, fishing tackle, a torch, fish, spring onions, and a sprinkler were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established glossary, fish and tackle names, dynamic placeholders, crop timing, fertilizer percentages, soil instructions, bite-rate behavior, object gender, and seasonal terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

SpangleSeeds_Description.source: Plant in summer. Takes 8 days to produce a vibrant tropical flower. Assorted colors.
SpangleSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le vara. Au nevoie de 8 zile pentru a produce o floare tropicală viu colorată. Culori asortate.

SpeedGro_Name.preservationReason: Speed-Gro is the canonical in-world brand spelling required by the approved Romanian glossary.

SpeedGro_Description.source: Stimulates leaf production. Guaranteed to increase growth rate by at least 10%. Mix into tilled soil.
SpeedGro_Description.translation: Stimulează producția de frunze. Garantează accelerarea creșterii cu cel puțin 10%. Amestecă-l în solul afânat.

SpiceBerry_Description.source: It fills the air with a pungent aroma.
SpiceBerry_Description.translation: Umple aerul cu o aromă înțepătoare.

Spinner_Description.source: The shape makes it spin around in the water. Slightly increases the bite-rate when fishing.
Spinner_Description.translation: Forma o face să se rotească în apă. Mărește ușor frecvența mușcăturilor la pescuit.

SpiritTorch_Description.source: It's unclear where the blue color comes from...
SpiritTorch_Description.translation: Nu este clar de unde provine culoarea albastră...

SpookFish_Description.source: The huge eyes can detect the faint silhouettes of prey.
SpookFish_Description.translation: Ochii uriași pot detecta siluetele abia vizibile ale prăzii.

SpringOnion_Description.source: These grow wild during the spring.

SpringSeeds_Description.source: An assortment of wild spring seeds.
SpringSeeds_Description.translation: Un amestec de semințe sălbatice de primăvară.

Sprinkler_Description.source: Waters the 4 adjacent tiles every morning.
Sprinkler_Description.translation: Udă cele 4 dale adiacente în fiecare dimineață.
